decisions.reason: The existing message-146 MODIFY already updates Small Block winner eligibility to current active ticket holders, including secondary buyers.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already updates Big Block winner eligibility to current active ticket holders, including secondary buyers.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already records that active Big Block prize tickets transfer to a secondary buyer; the ticket issuance and expiration rules remain unchanged.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already records that active Small Block prize tickets transfer to a secondary buyer; the ticket issuance and expiration rules remain unchanged.
The existing message-146 FAQ MODIFY already captures active-ticket transfer to secondary buyers and the revised explanation of current prize-ticket eligibility.
Changing the eligible prize-winner population does not alter primary-mint pricing or revenue allocation.
The eligible winner population does not change the established Winners-page announcement or one-click claim flow.
The winner-eligibility change does not alter which ticket counters, badges, or referral-code attributes must appear in NFT metadata.
Prize-winner eligibility does not change the amount, visibility, enforcement, or allocation of the secondary-sale royalty.
Prize-winner eligibility does not change the direct referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or payout mode.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already records that active prize tickets transfer to the secondary buyer.
The revised eligible winner population does not change the rule selecting a random existing NFT holder when no referral code is used.
